$comment: What a browser downloads for the client core and the React adapter, in KB gzip (Vite app mode, production, minified, dist/, without React and i18n).

Checked by packages/react/src/bundle-size.test.ts (roadmap E75). Limits are a ratchet: only ever lower them. A size more than 0.3 KB under its limit fails until the limit follows (BESPOKE_SIZE_BUDGET=update lowers it).
A ceiling (everything) is not ratcheted: the whole adapter may shift between chunks — during Wave 5c no more than 2 KB over its size when the wave started, since its end at most 31.0 (the last line).
stillLeaking: features in a scenario that does not use them. Wave 5c takes them out one by one, until every list is []. A new leak fails, and so does a listed one that is gone.

Raised once, in Wave 5c step 2 (E78, Max, 02.10.): core 18.7 → 19.7, emptyApp 23.0 → 24.0, minimalApp 26.6 → 27.6, blank-app 27.4 → 30.4, web-app 34.1 → 35.1 — the cost of splitting the navigator into modules (≈ +1.0 KB gzip: one more hop per access, less gzip sharing across modules). Step 4 takes the feature modules out of apps that do not use them. Otherwise E75 holds: limits only go down.

appsGzipKB is the marginal cost of core + adapter in the app's initial load (what the download loses without their bytes), since Wave 5c step 3 — not the attributed share, which grows with the number of modules (step 2: +2.96 KB attributed for +1.05 KB real). Set from the marginal sizes at a0057db: blank-app 24.44, web-app 33.79.

Raised once more, in Wave 5c step 3 (E79, Max, 02.10.): to the measured sizes + 0.1 — core 19.7 → 21.1, emptyApp 24.0 → 25.4, minimalApp 27.6 → 29.0, everything (ceiling) 35.9 → 36.4, blank-app 24.6 → 25.9, web-app 33.9 → 35.3 (marginal). The feature host (hooks, slots, history writer) while every feature is still attached by default. Cumulative temporary cost of E78 + E79: +2.4 KB gzip on core (18.58 after step 1 → 21.00) — to be recovered in step 4: EVERY step-4 commit must lower these limits, and there is no further raise without Max.

Wave 5c step 4 (one commit per feature): 4b queryState — core 21.1 → 20.8, emptyApp 25.4 → 25.1, minimalApp 29.0 → 28.6, blank-app 25.9 → 25.6. 4d remember — core 20.8 → 20.4, emptyApp 25.1 → 24.7, blank-app 25.6 → 25.2, web-app 35.3 → 35.1 (minimalApp keeps it: useForm remembers, statically). 4f actions (+ the pages' optimistic patches out of the core; in every app's router) — core 20.4 → 19.0, emptyApp 24.7 → 23.8, minimalApp 28.6 → 27.7, blank-app 25.2 → 24.3, web-app 35.1 → 34.2. everything stays at its ceiling (36.40): its gzip moves ±0.15 with the order of the modules in its one chunk, while its min shrank (109.4 → 109.2 KB). 4c liveValidation (loaded on a form's first use, E74 — a chunk of its own) — core 19.0 → 17.9, emptyApp 23.8 → 22.6, minimalApp 27.7 → 27.4, blank-app 24.3 → 23.2, web-app 34.2 → 34.1 (everything 36.40 → 36.28).

4dev (E80, Max, 02.10.: pulled forward instead of raising the everything ceiling): developer explanations only in development builds, production throws a code (packages/http/README.md, Error codes) — core 17.9 → 17.7, emptyApp 22.6 → 22.0, minimalApp 27.4 → 26.4, blank-app 23.2 → 22.2, web-app 34.1 → 32.4. everything 36.28 → 34.74 under its ceiling, which stays at 36.4: that headroom is what the step bought for 4g–4k and step 5.

4g prefetch (loaded with the first prefetch, E74 — a chunk of its own; hooks now run in the features' order, not the order they were attached) — core 17.7 → 17.2, web-app 32.4 → 32.3. emptyApp (21.82 → 21.94), minimalApp (26.29 → 26.37) and blank-app (22.06 → 22.08) keep their limits: they grew inside them, from what a lazy chunk costs, not from code — Vite's preload helper (the empty app's first import(); a real app has it for its pages anyway) and, with two lazy chunks, a third chunk for the modules both share (page, request, notify, feature: 2 initial chunks instead of 1). everything 34.74 → 34.95.

4h revalidateOnBack (resolveModulePages brings it, <BespokeApp> attaches it: every real app resolves its pages that way, so the apps keep it — blank-app 22.08, web-app 32.16) — core 17.2 → 17.0, emptyApp 22.0 → 21.9, minimalApp 26.4 → 26.3 (everything 34.95 → 34.99).

4j instant visits (loaded where an instant link renders, E74 — a chunk of its own; a visit before then goes without its placeholder) — core 17.0 → 16.6, emptyApp 21.9 → 21.6, minimalApp 26.3 → 26.1, blank-app 22.2 → 22.0, web-app 32.3 → 32.1 (everything 34.99 → 34.72). Done before 4i: the guard, taken out first, moved into another chunk of the web-app and made it +0.18 heavier (min −0.1 KB) — over its limit.

4i guard (static where a component guards: useBlocker, useForm/Form guard; a visit's own confirm is now the core's) — core 16.6 → 16.1, emptyApp 21.6 → 21.1, blank-app 22.0 → 21.5 (minimalApp keeps it: useForm guards). Raised (E81, Max, 02.10., until step 6 sets the chunk strategy): web-app 32.1 → 32.2 — the guard lands with state.ts in the web app's entry chunk beside react-dom instead of the shared framework chunk: +0.18 gzip at the same min (32.02 → 32.20). everything 34.76 → 34.79.

4k islands (attached where an island renders; the core keeps a small RegionOwner per entry on screen — entry, Back flag, signal, live regions — and the islands feature makes the regions on it) — core 16.1 → 14.4, emptyApp 21.1 → 19.4, minimalApp 26.1 → 24.4, blank-app 21.5 → 19.7, web-app 32.2 → 28.9 (its islands now come with the pages that show them, in their chunks). everything 34.79 → 34.87.

Step 5 layers (E71: a chunk the core loads when the server answers with a layer, a layer's request is sent or Back/Forward goes to a layer's entry; the React layer stack loads with it in the same round trip, <Link layer> loads it where it renders, createBespokeApp and the SSR entry before a deep link's document; the navigator lost its layer methods — the stack is each layer's host) — core 14.4 → 11.9, emptyApp 19.4 → 16.4, minimalApp 24.4 → 20.7, blank-app 19.7 → 16.5, web-app 28.9 → 26.2 (everything 34.87 → 31.83). No default feature is left: stillLeaking is [] in every scenario.

Step 6 — 6a: a visit under way is aborted when the document is left (core 11.72 → 11.73, within its limit). 6d chunk strategy: bespoke() splits an app's initial load into two chunks, vendor (third-party) and index (the rest), only $initial modules — lazy code stays in its own chunks (the web app's initial module set is unchanged); the scenarios are built the same way. Initial chunks web-app 9 → 3 (with rolldown's runtime), blank-app 3 → 3 (index, vendor, runtime), emptyApp 3 → 1, minimalApp 2 → 1. emptyApp 16.4 → 15.7, minimalApp 20.7 → 20.2, blank-app 16.5 → 15.6, web-app 26.2 → 23.3 (its whole initial load 99.83 → 95.73 KB gzip). everything 31.85 → 31.33.

6e optimistic on first use: the page's patches attach where one is made (useRouter's router.optimistic/reloading), not with every navigator; the core applies a visit's patches itself, of any target (patches.ts, +0.11 on core within its limit: 11.73 → 11.84). emptyApp 15.7 → 14.9, minimalApp 20.2 → 19.4, blank-app 15.6 → 14.8 (web-app 23.20 → 23.22 — it patches its pages).

6f uploads with progress (FormData over XHR) load with the first such upload, in a chunk of its own (a chunk that cannot load sends with fetch, without progress) — core 11.9 → 11.7 (11.84 → 11.54), emptyApp 14.9 → 14.5, minimalApp 19.4 → 19.1, blank-app 14.8 → 14.5, web-app 23.3 → 23.1.

6g progress bar opt-in (E82, Max, 02.10.): createBespokeApp({ progress: progressBar({ delay: 250 }) }) — the starters pass it, an app without it carries none of it (aria-busy stays: http/client/busy). emptyApp 14.40 → 13.99, minimalApp 18.91 → 18.49: limits 14.5 → 14.1, 19.1 → 18.6. blank-app 14.38 → 14.42 and web-app 22.91 → 22.95 (they opt in; the indicator wrapper, within their limits).

Measured without Vite's preload helper since the end of Wave 5c (Max, 02.10., option B2): the first import() of any client build brings it (≈ 0.5 KB gzip) — every app with lazy pages ships it whatever the framework does, so it is no framework code; the measured builds stub it (__fixtures__/bundle.ts). core 11.54 → 11.03, emptyApp 13.99 → 13.48, minimalApp 18.49 → 18.02, everything 31.09 → 30.60, blank-app 14.42 → 13.99, web-app 22.95 → 22.49.

FINAL STATE after Wave 5c (Max, 02.10., option A): the targets are the measured sizes + the tolerance — core 11.2, emptyApp 13.6, minimalApp 18.2, blank-app 14.1, web-app 22.6 (all ratchets, they keep going down); everything is a ceiling at 31.0 (+0.4: its one chunk's gzip moves with the order of its modules). The spike's targets (core ≤ 8.5, an app without pages ≤ 12.5, with Link + useForm ≤ 14) were missed, for reasons on record: splitting the navigator into modules costs +1.0 (E78: one more hop per access, less gzip sharing), the feature host +1.4 instead of the +0.7 estimated (E79), the core gained work the spike did not count — a visit's own confirm (4i, security), loading the layers when the server answers with one (E71), applying a visit's optimistic patches (6e) — and Link + useForm cost +4.5 over an app without pages instead of +1.5 (useForm's guard and remember stay static, by plan). Everything optional is out (stillLeaking is [] everywhere); what remains is the fixed core of E72, the security invariants and the adapter's basics. Before Wave 5c (a5ac296^, with the injection strings): core 19.33, emptyApp 23.66, minimalApp 27.21; peak after E79 (1e12d6e): core 21.00, emptyApp 25.29, minimalApp 28.85, web-app 35.17 marginal.

W6.10 live props (E110, Max, 03.10.): the everything ceiling 31.0 → 31.1 (measured 31.07: the useLiveUpdates hook +0.09, the core's server-driven live trigger +0.04, the islands' trigger and loader +0.05, the actions' send hook +0.01). The app limits stay as they are (core 11.2, emptyApp 13.6, minimalApp 18.2, blank-app 14.1, web-app 22.6): core 11.03 → 11.07, emptyApp 13.48 → 13.52, minimalApp 18.02 → 18.05, blank-app 13.99 → 14.02, web-app 22.50 → 22.53 — the core's +0.04 is the price of loading live when an answer follows a channel (like the layers, E71), accepted by E110.

W7.10 the docs app (apps/docs, E114/E133): its own limit from its first measurement, 17.22 → 17.3 (E75: from here only down). More than the blank app (14.02): <Link prefetch> in the navigation and the README links, useQueryState for the search (its module lands in the initial chunk: the search page, a lazy chunk, uses it), the progress bar, and useRouter() in the layout (the header's search visits) — which attaches the optimistic feature (≈ 0.8 KB: 16.4 without it, a full page load for a header search instead). The page chunks (README renderer, table of contents, search view) are lazy.

W8 step 8 tab sync (E149, Max, 04.10.: a default feature of createBespokeApp, the core's limit unchanged, the limits of the scenarios and apps that carry it raised ONCE by exactly its measured cost, no reserve — then the ratchet again). Savings first: the feature is a chunk of its own that createBespokeApp loads beside the first page's component and messages, before hydrating — statically in createBespokeApp it cost +0.93–0.99 (emptyApp 14.48, minimalApp 18.99, everything 32.05, blank-app 14.95, web-app 23.53, docs 18.18); lazily it costs the loader, its Promise.all slot and the features prop: +0.05–0.07. Measured before/after (d321705 → this step): core 11.07 → 11.07, emptyApp 13.52 → 13.58, minimalApp 18.05 → 18.11, everything 31.06 → 31.13, blank-app 14.02 → 14.07, web-app 22.57 → 22.63, docs 17.22 → 17.28. Limits: emptyApp 13.6 → 13.66, minimalApp 18.2 → 18.26, everything (ceiling) 31.1 → 31.17, blank-app 14.1 → 14.15, web-app 22.6 → 22.66, docs 17.3 → 17.36.
